visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An elderly woman with voluminous, purple-dyed messy hair wears a black face mask with white snowflake patterns and a black ribbed tank top. She is standing inside a brightly lit clothing store, surrounded by colorful t-shirts and stacks of plastic-wrapped merchandise. An off-screen interviewer holds a yellow microphone toward her as she gestures and talks. (2) The woman is shown in a medium shot, interacting with a red plastic-wrapped clothing package. She expertly ties a white plastic string while laughing, her eyes squinting behind the mask. Large, bold red variety text overlays appear on the screen to emphasize the revelation of her age, 74. (3) The scene cuts to an outdoor street setting in front of a blue metallic rolling shutter. The woman poses confidently, flexing her right arm to display a defined and muscular bicep. She smiles broadly, looking directly at the camera in a medium full shot. (4) Back inside the retail shop, the woman continues to discuss her personal style and family background. Various colorful graphics and variety text subtitles like "管我!" and "穿到我死" flash across the screen. The background is filled with racks of clothing in diverse colors, mainly pinks, purples, and yellows. (5) The video concludes with the woman throwing her head back in a joyful, open-mouthed laugh, showing her vibrant and energetic spirit despite her age.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with upbeat, rhythmic electronic pop BGM. A male interviewer speaks with very high energy and a fast speech rate. A percussive 'ding' sound effect highlights the reveal of the main character's age. (2) The elderly woman responds in a conversational, friendly voice. The background music remains continuous. Audible rustling sounds occur as she handles plastic clothing bags. A 'pop' SFX accompanies visual variety text. (3) The interviewer's voice increases in volume and pitch, expressing exaggerated shock. A quick 'whoosh' transition SFX marks the cut to the outdoor scene. The music maintains a steady dance beat with synthesized textures. (4) The woman explains her family background with a calm but confident vocal contour. Comedic cartoon sound effects punctuate her jokes. The BGM levels remain consistent throughout the dialogue. (5) The video ends with the woman's energetic laughter and a final melodic chime SFX as the music fades out abruptly with a hard cut.
